newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly flat to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly flat to lower.

text.p: Millfeed prices remained mostly steady to weaker Friday, capping a week-long downtrend, burdened by ample nearby supply and sluggish demand, dealers said.
Activity was subdued, but dealers said in several areas like the southeast and Oklahoma and Texas the wheat harvests were underway which would add pressure to midd prices.
"People have done their thing for the next few weeks and are just waiting it out for now," a Chattanooga dealer said.
He expects prices to trend lower in the next few weeks with supplies seen outpacing demand.
"It is still quiet and it seems there are more midds around than homes (for them)," a Kansas dealer said.
